title: Bitcoin faces $70,000 test as $14.2 billion stablecoin contraction exposes demand weakness
summary: Bitcoin is facing a fresh liquidity squeeze as mounting losses among recent buyers threaten to derail its recovery. Stablecoin supply has contracted by $14.2 billion over the past month, its sharpest decline since June 2022, while Bitcoin's apparent demand has fallen by 284,000 BTC, approaching levels last seen during the March 2025 market turmoil.
